rationale: AGI has gapped down ~7.9% with no news catalyst identified, making the move difficult to interpret directionally — it could be a sector rotation, earnings from a peer, or macro gold-price pressure. Price is sitting near the session low (13.8% of range) with declining 1-minute volume and no clear stabilization pattern, while the 9-EMA ($28.93) and VWAP ($29.02) are both above current price, suggesting continued downward pressure but also proximity to a potential bounce zone. Without a clear directional edge and with existing committed capital already deployed, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
